claims.name: fix-works
claims.risk: The parser still rejects or corrupts an equals sign inside a value, or breaks existing inputs.

claims.name: independent-expected-value
claims.risk: No added regression assertion compares parser output with a literal or independent worked example.

claims.name: new-test-catches-mutation
claims.risk: The added tests fail on the fixed parser, or do not fail an assertion when a value is truncated at its first equals sign.

claims.name: scope-kept
claims.risk: Files outside the parser and its tests changed, or the work was committed.

claims.name: test-explained
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer does not explain the regression example.
